explanation: In sacrebleu chrF++ (word_order=2), word n-grams are extracted via whitespace splitting. Because Chinese sentences have no inter-word whitespace, unsegmented sentences yield zero word bigram matches, heavily deflating raw chrF++ to ~14.05. When segmented into Chinese words, chrF++ is 22.72 for baseline and 23.59 for CLRR-Enc, aligning with BLEU.
